framework.ref: SEBI (Substantial Acquisition of Shares and Takeovers) Regulations, 2011
framework.note: Core regulation governing disclosure, timing, and public offer requirements for substantial acquisitions; Regulation 31(4) mandates disclosure within 4 trading days of crossing threshold or acquiring specified shareholding.
Defines 'person acting in concert' and aggregation rules; critical for determining if multiple parties must be treated as a single acquirer.
Prescribes open offer triggers at 25% threshold and timing/price determination for mandatory offer; may apply depending on shareholding crossed.
Pre-disclosure requirements before crossing threshold; must file within 2 days of acquisition; Regulation 31(4) is post-disclosure for acquisitions already crossed.

detail: Wockhardt Limited, a listed pharmaceutical company, has submitted a disclosure under Regulation 31(4) of the SEBI (Substantial Acquisition of Shares and Takeovers) Regulations, 2011 to the National Stock Exchange. This disclosure is mandatory when a party acquires 25% or more of voting capital, or has already acquired 25% and acquires a further 2% in any financial year (creeping acquisition). The filing does not specify the acquirer, consideration, or shareholding threshold crossed based on the article excerpt; the full details are contained in the NSE-filed PDF document dated 30 June 2026.

triggers.note: Mandatory disclosure within 4 trading days of acquiring substantial shareholding (25%+) or creeping acquisition (2%+ if already holding 25%+).
If 25%+ threshold crossed, triggers mandatory open offer at 26% of existing voting capital (floor) at price determined under Regulation 8.
Listed company must ensure continuous compliance with disclosure, corporate governance, and insider trading prohibitions during acquisition and open offer window.
